neighbours.label: the comparative connective that sets up a parallel case ('as with', 'as in', 'like' + a general class): the word after 'as' or the 'like' that frames 'this is true here as it is there'; 'like' as a manner simile and 'with' as an instrument stay low
fire: As with every new diet, results vary from person to person.
In Brazil, as in most of South America, coffee is cheap.
Like every software project, this one ran late.
As with all antiques, check the hallmarks before you buy.
In winter, as in summer, the market opens at dawn.
Like most big cities, Lagos has terrible traffic.
As with earlier models, the battery is hard to replace.
But like so many promises, this one was quietly forgotten.
quiet: With every new diet, she bought a different cookbook.
In Brazil, coffee is grown mostly on large farms.
She sang like a bird at the school concert.
Check the hallmarks with a magnifying glass before you buy.
In winter the market opens at dawn and closes at noon.
Lagos has terrible traffic during the rainy season.
The battery is hard to replace without special tools.
He made a promise and kept it for many years.

short: 'as with / as in / like' parallel-case frame
notes: Card: peaks ' with' x14 (As with any), ' as', ' like', 'Like'; + pole suppresses any/like. Probe: 'as in any other country' 0.645, 'As with any medication' 0.610, 'As with my brother' 0.610, 'As is the case with any sport' 0.406, 'Like any muscle' 0.346, 'like so many programs' 0.341; 'ran like the wind' 0.032, 'before using this medication' 0.078.
